findings.description: At phone widths (360 px) the table has min-width 760px but main uses overflow-x: clip, so the Amount column (and, for editors, the Actions column with Edit/Delete) is cut off and cannot be reached by scrolling. Phone users see only titles and categories, never the amounts, and editors cannot edit or delete expenses.
repro: Amount column is clipped at the right edge; no horizontal scroll is possible and Actions (editor) is unreachable

findings.description: The Amount column header is right-aligned, but the amount cells are left-aligned, so the values do not sit under their header and decimals do not line up for comparison.
repro: Compare the AMOUNT header (right-aligned) with the $ values (left-aligned)

notes: Checked login, list, category filter, add/edit forms, 404/403 pages and keyboard focus at 1280 and 360 px. Focus ring is visible. No other issues found; destructive actions (delete, save) were not exercised.

cost.notes: estimate from 26753 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0054-$0.0642
